verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler-based UI framework consumed as code (svelte-docs-4, svelte-gh-1). It has no product dashboard or UI whose actions need an equivalent API, so API/UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The 404 OpenAPI probe is irrelevant because there is no hosted service whose UI an API would mirror.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
